div.div:
Fine-grained Pipeline (Tile=4)
Stage 0: tile fetch (weights/activations)
Stage 1: data alignment & stagger
Stage 2: shared MAC compute
Stage 3: reduction + requantization
Stage 4: writeback / stream-out

div.div:
Implementation highlights:
Priority-based scheduler controls shared fabric ownership.
In-proj and DT-proj both use the same MAC datapath.
Pipeline completion triggers deterministic writeback/stream output.
